run_build_markdeep_utility: run the script to assemble and concatenate Markdeep preview blog JavaScript files into a single utility file
run_extract_html_head_body: run the script to extract head and body sections from PreviewBlogPage.htm using regex
run_replace_macros_in_js: run the script to replace document head, body prefix, and body suffix macros in PrepareHTML.js
run_generate_attribute_setters: run the script to generate JavaScript setAttribute calls for head and body HTML attributes
run_concatenate_js_sources: run the script to concatenate PrepareHTML.full.js, SetMarkdeepMode.js, markdeep.min.js, DisplayMarkdeepOutput.js, and InvokeMathJax.js into MarkdeepUtility.js
